tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa li ye/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni/ /srid zhi'i mig 'khrul cir yang 'char ba las/ /deng 'dir mkha' spyod dpal mo yid 'ong ma/ /snying nas dran no 'khyud pa'i brtse dgas skyongs/ /'og min zhing na lhan skyes rgyal yum ma/ /nyer bzhi'i yul na zhing skyes ḍā ki ma/ /nor 'dzin khyab pa'i karma mu tra ma/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi skyabs mchog rje btsun ma/ /khyod ni sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal te/ /rdo rje'i grong na e dbyings bam̐ gyi dngos/ /sgyu ma'i gling na 'jigs rung srin mo dang / /'dzum dkar g.yo ba'i lang tsho gsar pa ston/ /bdag gis ji ltar btsal yang 'phags ma khyod/ /bden pa grub pa'i nges pa ma rnyed nas/ /spros pas dub pa'i sems kyi gzhon nu de/ /brjod bral nags kyi khang bur ngal gso rten/ /e ma da ni ḍā ki dbyings nas bzhengs/ /he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog /bklag pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs/ /oṃ ḍi bi sha'i bas mtha'i nags khrod du/ /grub pa'i dbang po rdo rje dril bu pa/ /'khyud dang tsum+bha'i bde bas rjes bskyangs te/ /kha sbyor mchog gi rol bzhin bdag kyang skyongs/ /gaṅgā'i gling du rje btsun ku sa li/ /mngon sum nam mkha'i dbyings su 'khrid pa dang / /dpal ldan nā ro ta pa rjes bzung ltar/ /bdag kyang mkha' spyod dge ba'i grong du khrid/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gi thugs rje dang / /rgyud chen gsang mtha'i myur lam zab khyad dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dad pa'i mthus/ /mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal myur mthong shog /ces kyang thol byung du smras so/ /pha bla ma'i gsung mchog tu byin rlabs che ba zhig yin pas/ mkha' spyod don gnyer rnams kyis kha 'don du mdzod cig/ //
